1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

Issue Number: close #51399

Problem Summary:

### What changed and how does it work?

### Check List

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [x] Unit test
- [ ] Integration test
- [ ] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)
- [ ] No need to test
  > - [ ] I checked and no code files have been changed.
  > <!-- Or your custom  "No need to test" reasons -->

Side effects

- [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more CPU
- [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more Memory
- [ ] Breaking backward compatibility

Documentation

- [ ] Affects user behaviors
- [ ] Contains syntax changes
- [ ] Contains variable changes
- [ ] Contains experimental features
- [ ] Changes MySQL compatibility

### Release note

<!-- compatibility change, improvement, bugfix, and new feature need a release note -->

Please refer to [Release Notes Language Style Guide](https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/release-notes-style-guide.html) to write a quality release note.

```release-note
None
```

issue_context.title: tidb config doesn't take effects when there are invalid config
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)
1. write config like
```
  global:
    user: "guojiangtao"
    ssh_port: 22
    deploy_dir: "/home/guojiangtao/work/tiup_cluster/s3/data/deploy"
    data_dir: "/home/guojiangtao/work/tiup_cluster/s3/data/data"
    arch: "amd64"

  server_configs:
    tidb:
      mem-quota-query: 1073741824
      log.file.max-backups: 10
      log.file.max-days: 5
      log.slow-threshold: 1000
      disaggregated-tiflash: true
      new_collations_enabled_on_first_bootstrap: false
      oom-action: log
      performance.enforce-mpp: 1
      performance.txn-total-size-limit: 107374182
...
```
2. tiup cluster setup new cluster
3. check `disaggregated-tiflash` config: `show config where name like '%disagg%'`
<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
tidb config is correct
### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
`disaggregated-tiflash` config is wrong
![ed8e4b65-0641-421e-b169-d883cd75ccd2](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/assets/7493273/04ef5e82-d2f4-418b-b268-407c11e85e4d)

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)
v7.5.0
<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
comments: Actually tidb should report error because `perofrmance.enforce-mpp: 1` should be `performance.enforce-mpp: true`, but tidb miss checking return error of parsing config, [code](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/pkg/config/config.go#L1266), which cause the config is default value

review_comments: Does this err will display in log file? It user set a wrong config, and it's better to let they konw why tidb cannot start.
Yes, the error log will like `toml: line 5 (last key \"performance.enforce-mpp\"): incompatible types: TOML value has type int64; destination has type boolean`
I'm curious how it works because I remeber `global config` is inited before `logger`. If `global config` init failed, `logger` will not work
